fieldNotes.location: Roster point (35.156146,-86.510063, geocode ROOFTOP, moved 93 m) landed directly on the plant. Web research confirmed 101 Industrial Blvd, Fayetteville TN 37334 - a Frito-Lay manufacturing plant operating since 1997 (~500 employees; the company bought the plant from Eagle Snacks). Street View confirmed the plant with silos and Frito-Lay/Eagle-era trailers.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The plant access road runs from a wide entrance off US-64; Street View (2023 pano) shows a checkpoint structure with yellow bollards at the entrance to the plant proper, and the trailer drop yard is enclosed by chain-link fencing. Controlled truck gate confirmed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small structure with yellow bollards sits at the plant entrance pinch-point in Street View - reads as a guard/check-in booth. Classified guardShack true; flagged uncertain (could not confirm it is staffed).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors with trailers backed in along multiple building faces (north, south); total well into the 50+ band (~55 estimated).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop yards on the NE side (large fenced lot) and the west/SW side - dozens of trailers in rows, 50+ stalls combined.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane entrance apron off US-64 with abundant paved width suggests room for an express/bypass lane; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible reaching the property; the NE boundary is a divided highway (US-64), not rail. railServed false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: The plant sits in a small-town industrial area on the edge of Fayetteville, surrounded by woods and farm fields - Rural.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large continuous manufacturing-distribution building; counted as 1 despite multiple roof sections.
